mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing borrowing costs and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, always-on.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by > 200K in a month, the combined signal of a tight labor market and strong job growth drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by > 2% in a month, indicating supply chain disruptions, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high and rising GDP (GDPC1) above $19 trillion, indicating strong aggregate demand, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 > $19 trillion.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) growth rate exceeds 3% YoY, the combined signal of tightening monetary policy and high inflation drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment claims (implied by PAYEMS decline > 100K in a month), signaling labor market stress, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high and stable retail sales figure (RSAFS) above $525 billion, indicating consistent consumer spending, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when RSAFS > $525 billion.
